key_insight: RenalTransLSTM combines LSTM and Transformer layers to predict ICU acute kidney injury up to 24 hours ahead using recent patient history.
clinical_relevance: Earlier AKI risk detection could support proactive ICU monitoring and decision support, especially for patients with evolving risk profiles.
method: Trained on 48-hour EHR time-series from MIMIC-IV (61,735 admissions).
Compared against SVM, XGBoost, LSTM, TG-LSTM, and Transformer baselines; used Integrated Gradients and counterfactual analysis for interpretability.
evidence_signal: The model achieved AUROC above 0.90 and F1-scores up to 0.85 across horizons, with ablation studies showing added value from combining LSTM and Transformer components.
watch_item: Performance was shown on retrospective ICU data, so real-world prospective validation and careful integration into clinical workflows are still needed.
paper_title: RenalTransLSTM: Multi-Horizon Prediction of Acute Kidney Injury in ICU Patients using a Hybrid LSTM-Transformer Architecture
